explanation: The statement says the coefficient vector (indexed by Fin 1) of X - C c is the constant function -c. It reduces to coeff (X - C c) 0 = -c. I searched Mathlib for coeff_X_sub_C-style lemmas and for direct statements of coeff (X - C c) 0. I found only coeff_X_sub_C_mul, which is unrelated. I found no declaration for the constant coefficient of X - C c, and none about Fin 1 coefficient vectors. The library proves it with funext, fin_cases and simp using coeff_X, so no single Mathlib lemma matches.
